title: Ubufasha
intro: Uko wavugana n'itsinda rikwitaho n'uko wabona ubufasha kuri iyi porogaramu.
notEmergency: Iyi porogaramu si iy'ibihe byihutirwa. Niba wumva urembye cyane, jya ku kigo nderabuzima kikwegereye ubu.
noAdviceMore: Itsinda rikwitaho ni ryo ryonyine rishobora kukubwira icyo ibisubizo byawe bisobanuye kuri wowe.
callbackDisabled: Tanga uruhushya kugira ngo wohereze ubusabe
helpHint: Ibisubizo bigufi ku ikoreshwa ry'iyi porogaramu

callback.title: Saba ko baguhamagara
callback.intro: Itsinda rikwitaho rishobora kuguhamagara ku kibazo ufite.

topics.appointment_question: Ikibazo kijyanye na gahunda yo kwa muganga

callback.noteHint: Ntiwandike hano amakuru yihariye y'ubuzima bwawe.
callback.sendHint: Itsinda rikwitaho rihabwa igikorwa cyo kuguhamagara
callback.sendError: Ubusabe bwawe ntibwoherejwe. Nta cyahindutse. Ongera ugerageze.
callback.successBody: Itsinda rikwitaho rizagerageza kuguhamagara. Iri ni igerageza — nta muntu uzaguhamagara koko.
callback.disabled: Tanga uruhushya kugira ngo wohereze ubusabe. Ushobora gukomeza gusoma ingingo z'ubufasha.
callback.noPersona: Hitamo umuntu w'igerageza kandi utange uruhushya kugira ngo wohereze ubusabe.
